title: Console pulse + askboard capture 2027-09-09
content:
Meeting: Console & Tooling — pulse + askboard capture
Date: 2027-09-09
Facilitator: Ava Martinez
Attendees: Marcus, Rosa, Devon, Liam, (quick FYI: Sana was OOO)
Duration: 20m (sync + ad-hoc decisions)

1) Quick context / why this note
- Weekly capture focused on UI rollouts, lightweight analytics checks, and 'askboard' — the small list of asks we track for emergent fixes during canaries.
- Goal: keep runbook concise, surface one actionable owner per open item, and record metric deltas we care about.

2) Wins / positive signals - Canary 3 for panel-resize landed yesterday (PR #4682). Early telemetry shows median render time down from ~320ms -> ~245ms for 90% of sessions.
- Frontend error budget: JS exceptions dropped 18% in last 24h for the impacted route (CON-2213 tags).
- UX quick feedback from customer success: fewer reported layout shifts in Firefox (2 reports -> 0 since canary).

3) Current metrics snapshot (09-09 09:00 PT)
- Panel render median: 245ms
- Panel render p95: 710ms (note: p95 still elevated on slow mobile networks)
- Topline throughput for panel routes: 4.8k reqs/min
- Canary conversion (feature acceptance metric): +2.3% vs control (early signal)

4) Active blockers / risks
- Telemetry schema mismatch for the new resize event (backend uses "panel_resize_v2"; frontend emitted "panel.resize.v2"). This prevents accurate aggregation in the dash. Impact: canary telemetry dashboard missing 12h of events.
  - Owner: Marcus.
  - Mitigation: temporary ETL shim in observability that normalizes both keys; ETA 09-11.
- Autosuggest A/B gating not honoring rollout flags for 0.5% of requests (suspected race in feature-flag evaluation cache). Impact: small exposure of experimental UI to stable cohorts.
  - Owner: Rosa.
  - Short-term: ramp down gate to 0.1%. Root-cause debug in progress (CON-2213).

5) Decisions taken in-sync
- Proceed with full canary promotion to 25% on Monday provided p95 drops below 800ms for three consecutive 6-hour windows. (Owner: Ava to approve)
- Defer additional CSS micro-optimizations until after telemetry fix to avoid skewing render metrics.

6) Action items (owner -> due)
- Marcus -> implement ETL shim to map panel.resize.v2 -> panel_resize_v2 and add test coverage (due 2027-09-11).
- Rosa -> patch feature-flag cache invalidation path and post run details in CON-2213 (due 2027-09-12).
- Devon -> update canary dashboard panels: add mobile network filter and a 6h rolling window visualization (due 2027-09-13).
- Liam -> coordinate a short UX session with CS to capture the 3 reproducible reports from Firefox users (due 2027-09-14).
- Ava -> sign-off on 25% ramp if p95 < 800ms across windows (checkpoint 2027-09-13 10:00 PT).

7) Notes from quick triage (informal)
- Observability oddity: session sampling rate appears lower in EU region; double-check ingestion config for the eu cluster. (possible ENV var mismatch)
- Small TODO: add a lightweight synthetic that runs panel-render across 3 mobile throttles and posts results to #panel-telemetry daily.

8) Follow-ups / parking lot
- Revisit the rollout cadence doc: current rollout steps assume uniform telemetry shape; need a short appendix for 'sparse telemetry' scenarios. (parking owner: Ava)
- Discuss fallback UX for clients with JS disabled — not in scope for this sprint but flagged by security review.

9) Quick links / refs discussed in meeting: 
- Jira: CON-2213 (feature gating + telemetry)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4682 (panel-resize refactor)
- Dash (obs): internal.redwood.ai/obs/metric-dashboards#panel-render
- Design notes: confluence:console-panel-designs-draft

10) Meeting freeform / notes-to-self (chaotic but useful)
- Remember: when telemetry keys change, prefer safe mapping on ingestion rather than changing historical dashboards. (so we keep continuity)
- Call with infra about eu ingestion tomorrow at 11:30 — add to calendar.
- Quick experiment idea: track first-paint & first-contentful-paint for the panel route; correlate to customer-reported 'slow startup' tickets. If correlation strong, prioritize network preconnect.

11) Next sync
- Time: next weekly pulse, 2027-09-16 09:00 PT; quick 15m check-in before standup if canary trends shift.

---
Raw / scratch lines captured during the call (unaltered):
- "canary looks healthy but p95 weird spikes around 2:30am"
- "we should add ETL.mapper before the dash, less risky than touching frontend"
- "Sana: forward UX repro steps when back"

End of capture.
